name: Megiddo
line: Megiddo was a city on the edge of the plain of Esdraelon, a famous battlefield where two kings of Judah, Ahaziah and Josiah, met their deaths.

moments.title: Ahaziah dies at Megiddo
moments.text: King Ahaziah of Judah fled from Jehu and was shot in his chariot. He escaped to Megiddo and died there.

moments.title: Josiah goes to battle
moments.text: Neco of Egypt warned Josiah to stop opposing God, but Josiah did not listen. He disguised himself and went to fight on the Plain of Megiddo.

moments.title: Josiah is killed
moments.text: Pharaoh Neco killed King Josiah at Megiddo. His servants carried his body from there to Jerusalem, where he was buried in his own tomb.
